_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Ice Nations#000.src: ...You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#000.dst: …実はな、我々が難破したのは自然のせいではない。襲われたのだ…

Ice Nations#002.src: Talk to Adigard on the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Ice Nations#002.dst: {p} の [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Adigard と話す

Ice Nations#003.src: Welcome traveler, to our humble island...
Ice Nations#003.dst: ようこそ旅人、我らの小さな島へ…
Ice Nations#003.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#004.src: My people and I landed here many years ago. Unfortunately, our ship didn't make it...
Ice Nations#004.dst: 私と民は何年も前にこの地に流れ着いた。不幸にも、船は持たなかった…
Ice Nations#004.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#005.src: We tried to build a nation on these islands but became divided through the years.
Ice Nations#005.dst: この島々に国を築こうとしたが、年月とともに分裂してしまった。
Ice Nations#005.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#006.src: Because of this, we are fighting a useless war with our neighbours.
Ice Nations#006.dst: そのせいで、隣人と無益な戦争をしている。
Ice Nations#006.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#007.src: I believe we should try to pass a peace treaty, but I am afraid of getting killed if I leave the island...
Ice Nations#007.dst: 和平条約を結ぶべきだと思うが、島を離れれば殺されるのではと恐れている…
Ice Nations#007.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#008.src: Would you mind helping us? Talk to Hallfred about this treaty. He lives on another ice island nearby.
Ice Nations#008.dst: 手を貸してくれないか？条約について Hallfred と話してくれ。近くの別の氷の島に住んでいる。
Ice Nations#008.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#009.src: Talk to Hallfred about the peace treaty
Ice Nations#009.dst: 和平条約について Hallfred と話す

Ice Nations#010.src: Welcome traveler! What brings you to our island?
Ice Nations#010.dst: ようこそ旅人！俺たちの島に何の用だ？
Ice Nations#010.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#011.src: Oh, I see that Adigard now sends strangers through his cowardice! Worried he'll get killed?
Ice Nations#011.dst: ほう、Adigard の奴、臆病風に吹かれてよそ者を寄越したか！殺されるのが怖いんだろ？
Ice Nations#011.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#012.src: This is the last time I'll repeat it: We will sign the peace treaty the day Adigard and his nation will return to us... the treasure.
Ice Nations#012.dst: これが最後だ。Adigard とその国が俺たちに…宝を返した日に、和平条約に署名してやる。
Ice Nations#012.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#013.src: The one that they kept and hid from us after the shipwreck.
Ice Nations#013.dst: 難破の後、奴らが隠して独り占めしたやつだ。
Ice Nations#013.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#014.src: Pure gold, very valuable and rare! Tell him I'll be waiting for it. And none of that silly story again.
Ice Nations#014.dst: 純金だ、貴重で希少なんだ！待ってると伝えろ。あのくだらん作り話はもう無しだぞ。
Ice Nations#014.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#015.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response
Ice Nations#015.dst: Hallfred の返事を Adigard に伝える

Ice Nations#016.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#016.dst: 予想すべきだった。Hallfred は昔から強欲でな…
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#017.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#017.dst: 宝など持っていないと分からせようとしたが、うまくいかなかった。
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#018.src: ... You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#018.dst: …実はな、我々が難破したのは自然のせいではない。襲われたのだ…
Ice Nations#018.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#019.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#019.dst: 誰に？亡者だ。化け物のような船を操る幽霊と悪魔。不意を突かれた。
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#020.dst: 宝もその襲撃で奪われたのだと思う。
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#021.dst: 我らの国を再び一つにしてくれないか？その船を見つけ、宝を Hallfred に届けてくれ。そうすればやっと平和に暮らせる。
Ice Nations#021.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#022.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#022.dst: 北へ航海してくれ。何年も前に奴らが我々を襲った場所だ。見つけやすいはずだ、きっと堂々と停泊している…ありがとう。
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#023.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred
Ice Nations#023.dst: 幽霊船を見つけ、[Ancient Treasure] を Hallfred に届ける

Ice Nations#024.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#024.dst: 信じられん！本当に宝を渡してきやがった！
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#025.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#025.dst: これで俺たちの国の戦争も終わりってわけだ！
Ice Nations#025.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#026.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#026.dst: めでたい日だ！ほら、国を助けてくれた礼にこれをやる。
Ice Nations#026.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#027.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#027.dst: この兜もいつか役に立つだろうさ！
Ice Nations#027.speaker: Hallfred
